chosenApproach: Preserve the already verified visual staging preview as base; reconcile dev governance and isolated disabled rewards source into one scoped staging candidate. Add read-only carryover policy, admin visibility and strict EAS stage-only workflow without production writes.
selectionRationale: The combined source reduces feature omission while keeping backend rewards disabled and production season1 isolated; exact-scope regression and release gates prevent silent drift. Historical production update IDs are evidence of publish ordering, not an eternal head pin; a later legitimate production OTA must not block staging when the current served production manifest is reverified unchanged after publication. Updated cumulative scope explicitly includes and tests every merged PR #963 path, rather than suppressing protected-feature gate.

Build a parallel non-integrated standalone preview: rejected because duplicate feature definitions would drift
